paper.title_en: Criterion and Construction Framework for Impure Quantum $(r,δ)$-LRCs from Optimal $(r,δ)$-LRCs
paper.abstract_en: This paper aims to uncover new phenomena and provide new tools for quantum \((r,δ)\)-LRCs derived from optimal \((r,δ)\)-LRCs. The initial motivation is to identify the main reason for the existence of impure cases in such quantum codes. Our main result reveals that whether \(d = r+1\) is the key factor governing the impurity of quantum \((r,δ)\)-LRCs. We prove that, when \(d \neq r+1\), impure quantum codes derived from optimal \((r,δ)\)-LRCs have bounded lengths. Conversely, when \(d = r+1\), we construct impure quantum \((r,δ)\)-LRCs with unbounded lengths. The central tool developed in this work is a criterion for identifying impure quantum codes derived from optimal \((r,δ)\)-LRCs. The main results include a criterion for impurity in quantum \((r,δ)\)-LRCs (Theorem 3.2), a construction framework for impure quantum \((r,δ)\)-LRCs (Theorem 4.4), and two families of impure quantum \((r,δ)\)-LRCs (Theorems 4.8 and 4.11).
